01About

About Sudhir Kumar

Good design is a business decision made visible. I work where strategy, craft and production meet, so the idea that wins the room is the same one that ships.

SKSudhir Kumar
Ambala, Haryana, India

I work independently and directly with founders and marketing teams, mostly across time zones. That means no layers between the brief and the person doing the work, and a single consistent hand across logo, website, campaign and motion.

Fifteen years in, my practice has widened from pixels to systems: template libraries that whole member communities use, print kits that hold up on a convention floor, and products I design and build myself.

04Case studies

The thinking behind the work

Three projects, opened up: the problem, the approach and what changed.

Turning a graphics library into a motion library

Funnels in the library
4
Niche template sets
4
Formats: static & motion
2

Challenge

Members across very different niches needed promotional assets they could personalise quickly, and static banners were no longer enough.

Approach

I organised the library by funnel and niche, tightened the review loop for errors, and rebuilt key templates as short animated promos that stay fully editable.

Outcome

One coherent library that members can use for both static and video promotion, with a clear structure for adding new niches.

05Creative process

Five steps, no surprises

A clear path from first call to final files, so you always know what happens next.

  1. Step 01

    Discover

    I start with the business: audience, offer, competitors and what success looks like.

    • Kick-off workshop
    • Audit & benchmarks
    • Project brief
  2. Step 02

    Define

    We agree the idea before the pixels: positioning, structure and creative direction.

    • Creative direction
    • Site map & flows
    • Moodboards
  3. Step 03

    Design

    The direction becomes real, on real content, in the formats it will actually live in.

    • Identity & UI design
    • Prototypes
    • Motion tests
  4. Step 04

    Refine

    Structured review rounds, with every change checked against the original goals.

    • Feedback rounds
    • Detail & polish
    • Accessibility checks
  5. Step 05

    Deliver

    Clean files, clear documentation and support through launch and beyond.

    • Production files
    • Guidelines
    • Launch support
